title: Equity Audit Checklist
description: Ten items, five categories, and a callout that always names one thing to do rather than a score to feel bad about.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Building Trust and Representation in Your Club

educational.audience: Club leaders running an honest self-check

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given the club's own current practices, the learner scores each of five equity-audit categories on a simple present/partial/absent scale and identifies the lowest-scoring category as the next priority.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Score each item absent, partial, or present; the weakest category and its weakest item are named live
pedagogical.assessment: Run it on the real club and leave with one named action.
